Physical space: Outdoor mountain scenic boardwalk trail on Jingshan Park, Zhuhai. An elevated wooden-plank walkway curves around a steep granite hillside covered with dense subtropical trees and green foliage on the left. On the right, a silver stainless-steel safety railing with wire mesh netting overlooks an open panoramic vista of a coastal bay with a sandy crescent beach, forested hills, and distant city skyscrapers under an overcast cloudy sky. Several other tourists are walking in the distance.
Objects: Wooden deck planks underfoot; curved metal handrails with wire mesh netting on both sides; multiple large closed patio umbrellas with dark brown fabric mounted on square concrete anchor bases, interconnected along the walkway by a continuous orange safety cord; natural granite boulders and lush greenery along the left embankment; a lamppost equipped with a surveillance camera and digital sign panel; a white pavilion building with a blue ocean/dolphin mural in the distance.
Screen content: None; no phone or computer displays in view.
Text in the world: In the far distance on the pavilion mural, large white Chinese characters read '珠海'.
Media being played: None.
Ambient audio: Coastal and mountain breeze, faint rustling leaves, distant footsteps and indistinct conversations of tourists.

segments.environment: Physical space: An outdoor covered queue and boarding platform for a mountain alpine coaster (Wiegand toboggan coaster). The station is covered by a white fabric canopy supported by steel arched beams and posts. To the right is a stone retaining wall against a steep wooded hillside, an umbrella, and a queue lane partitioned by stainless steel railings. To the left is an open downward-sloping hillside dense with trees and green vegetation. Multiple visitors are queued in line, and platform XXX members wearing light grey longsleeves and dark trousers manage passenger boarding. Objects: Tubular steel track rails running down the platform slope, carrying a train of connected coaster sleds in grey, red, green, and yellow equipped with molded bucket seats, central hand brake levers, safety belts, and black mesh backrests. A freestanding brown notice board on the right labeled 'cableway / 滑道乘坐重要须知', a silver angular pole, and a ceiling-mounted flat-screen TV monitor on the left. Screen content: Overhead TV monitor displays live CCTV surveillance footage of the station queue and boarding deck. Text in the world: Signboard titled 'cableway / 滑道乘坐重要须知' listing boarding rules including '为了提升游客乘坐体验并确保安全', '乘坐滑车按两人一车安排', '车成一组发车，每组只安排一台滑车单人乘坐', '乘坐滑车下山过程中请勿拍照', '听从工作人员指挥，严禁中途停车', and '老弱病残孕及1.1米以下儿童禁止乘坐滑车'. Sled backrests labeled 'Wiegand' and numbered. Media played: Live queue CCTV surveillance XXX on the overhead TV. Ambient audio: Background mountain breeze, rustling leaves, visitors talking in low voices, and mechanical rattling from coaster sleds on the rails.

segments.action: I stand in the waiting queue under the white canopy tent at the alpine coaster station, glancing at the queue railings, stone retaining wall, and safety signboard.
segments.action_brief: I wait in the coaster queue.
segments.environment: Physical Space: An outdoor alpine coaster (toboggan/cableway) station boarding area situated on a mountain slope under an arched white canopy shelter. On the right is a stone retaining wall and a stone staircase with yellow step edges leading up the hill. Ahead and to the left is the downhill coaster track with metal rails, surrounded by dense green forest and trees. Objects: Stainless steel queue railings dividing the visitor path, an overhead electric fan mounted to a canopy pillar, a large red parasol umbrella next to a dark brown standing safety notice board, several plastic coaster sleds (red, green, yellow; branded Wiegand) on the left track, and a suspended CCTV monitor screen mounted to the canopy frame. Other People: Several tourists queueing in front of me wearing casual summer clothes, and XXX members in light grey hooded sun-protective jackets managing sleds on the platform track. Screen Content: A suspended LCD CCTV monitor displaying live camera feeds of the attraction. World Text: Signboard titled '滑道乘坐重要须知' with 'cableway' logo, listing safety rules and restrictions. Ambient Audio: Outdoor nature sounds, rustling leaves, quiet chatter of queueing visitors, and background XXX announcements.

segments.environment: a) PHYSICAL SPACE: Inside a brightly lit Chaoshan beef hotpot restaurant (八合里). The dining area has booth seating with brown leather upholstery, modern curved ceiling accents with spotlights, warm pendant illumination, and glass partition panels. Other customers and restaurant XXX are seated and walking in the background aisles. b) OBJECTS: In the center of the grey stone dining table is a built-in recessed burner with a metal pot of boiling yellow-tinted broth containing meatballs and vegetables. A long-handled metal ladle rests inside the pot, and a pair of wooden chopsticks is placed across the rim. On the left side of the table sits a black thermal pitcher, a shallow black dish with wide rice noodles, a woven basket of green leafy vegetables, a set of white ceramic dining ware (bowl, saucer, spoon) with black chopsticks, and a black smartphone. On the right side sits a small sauce bowl, a white bowl of noodles on a saucer, a white teacup, a paper takeout bag, a clear glass bowl, a green takeaway beverage cup with a straw, and another smartphone. Across the table on the right sits a female dining companion in a black sleeveless top gesturing with her right hand. c) SCREEN CONTENT: None XXX; smartphones on the table are turned off. d) TEXT IN THE WORLD: Wall posters display '八合里 潮汕味道牛肉火锅', '全国直营门店200+', and '连续8年 大众点评必吃榜'; the bottom-left corner of the table features red table number sticker '030'. e) MEDIA BEING PLAYED: None. f) AMBIENT AUDIO: Hotpot broth boiling, distant restaurant chatter, clinking cutlery.

Physical space: An indoor dining hall of a Baheli Beef Hotpot restaurant. Booth seating with padded brown benches and frosted glass dividers illuminated with warm yellow lighting. screen_text.label: Laptop Screen - AI XXX / Notes
screen_text.text:
Kernel PCA (核主成分分析)
Kernel PCA 是经典 PCA（主成分分析）的非线性扩展。核心思想是：通过一个非线性映射把原始数据映射到高维特征空间，再在该空间中使用线性 PCA，从而提取原始数据中的非线性结构。

为什么需要 Kernel PCA？
标准 PCA 只能发现数据中的线性结构。如果数据分布在一个弯曲的流形上（比如同心圆环、瑞士卷），线性 PCA 提取的主成分无法有效分离不同类别。Kernel PCA 就是为了解决这个问题。

核心原理
假设有一个映射函数 Φ，将原始数据 x 映射到一个更高维（甚至是无限维）的特征空间中。在子空间中做线性 PCA，等价于对映射后的数据协方差矩阵做特征值分解。
关键的“核技巧”（Kernel Trick）在于：我们不需要显式地计算 Φ(x)，只要计算数据点之间的核函数值 k(x_i, x_j) = <Φ(x_i), Φ(x_j)>。这样就避免了在高维空间中直接运算的巨大开销。

算法步骤
screen_text.summary: XXX explanation and mathematical formulas describing Kernel PCA and the kernel trick.

screen_text.label: Laptop Screen - Algorithm Steps
screen_text.text:
算法步骤
1. 选择一个核函数 k（如 RBF、多项式核等），计算 n×n 的核矩阵 K，其中 K_ij = k(x_i, x_j)。
2. 对核矩阵进行中心化（算法构造，使映射后的数据在特征空间中零均值）。
3. 对中心化后的核矩阵做特征值分解，取最大的若干个特征值对应的特征向量。
4. 特征向量归一化后，即可用于将新数据投影到主成分方向。

常用核函数
• RBF（高斯核）：k(x, y) = exp(-γ||x - y||²)，最常用，能处理各种非线性结构，无限维特征空间。
• 多项式核：k(x, y) = (γ<x, y> + c)^d，适合某些具有多项式关系的特征。

screen_text.label: MacBook Laptop Screen — Kernel PCA Notes
text: Kernel PCA 是经典 PCA（主成分分析）的非线性扩展。核心思想是：先通过一个核函数将数据隐式地映射到高维特征空间，再在这个空间中做线性 PCA，从而捕捉原始数据中的非线性结构。
标准 PCA 只能发现数据中的线性结构。如果数据分布在一个弯曲的流形上（比如同心圆环、瑞士卷），线性 PCA 提取的主成分无法有效分开不同类别。Kernel PCA 就是为了解决这个问题。
假设有一个映射函数 φ，将原始数据 x 映射到一个更高维（甚至无限维）的特征空间。在这个空间中做线性 PCA，关键在于计算映射后数据的协方差矩阵的特征分解。
关键的“核技巧”（Kernel Trick）在于：我们不需要显式地计算 φ(x)，只需要计算数据点之间的核函数值 k(x_i, x_j) = <φ(x_i), φ(x_j)>。这样就避免了在高维空间中直接运算的巨大开销。
1. 选择一个核函数 k（如 RBF、多项式核等），计算 n×n 的核矩阵 K，其中 K_ij = k(x_i, x_j)。
2. 对核矩阵进行中心化（减去均值，使得映射后的数据在特征空间中零均值）。
3. 对中心化后的核矩阵做特征分解，取最大的若干个特征值对应的特征向量。
4. 将特征向量归一化后，即可用于将新数据投影到低维空间。
• 高斯（RBF）核函数：k(x, y) = exp(-γ||x - y||^2)，最常用，能拟合各种非线性结构。参数 γ 控制宽度。

screen_text.text:
Kernel PCA 介绍
常用核函数
- RBF (高斯核) : K(x, y) = exp(-\gamma ||x - y||^2), 最常用, 能处理多种非线性结构, \gamma 控制带宽。
- 多项式核 : K(x, y) = (\gamma \langle x, y \rangle + c)^d, 适合具有多项式关系的特征。
- Sigmoid 核 : K(x, y) = tanh(\alpha \langle x, y \rangle + c), 类似神经网络的激活。

与标准 PCA 的对比
维度 | 标准 PCA | Kernel PCA
映射 | 线性投影 | 非线性高维映射
计算 | 特征值分解协方差矩阵 | 核矩阵特征值分解
可解释性 | 主成分为原特征线性组合 | 隐式映射难以直观解释
复杂度 | 低 | 高 (O(N^3))

适用场景与局限
适合: 数据具有强非线性结构, 样本量不大 (因计算复杂度为 O(N^3), 用于复杂分类前特征提取)。
局限: 对超参数敏感 (如 RBF 核的 \gamma), 无法显式重构原始样本 (需借助 Pre-image 算法), 对大数据集扩展性差。

screen_text.label: Claude AI web page on laptop display
text: 标准 PCA 只能发现数据中的线性结构。如果数据分布在一个弯曲的流形上（比如同心圆环、瑞士卷），线性 PCA 提取的主成分无法有效分离不同类别。Kernel PCA 就是为了解决这个问题。
假设有一个映射函数 Φ，将原始低维数据 x 映射到一个更高维（甚至无限维）的特征空间 F。在 F 中做标准 PCA，就等价于对映射后的数据进行非线性的主成分分解。
关键的“核技巧”（Kernel Trick）在于：我们不需要显式地计算 Φ(x)，只需要计算数据点之间的核函数值 k(xi, xj) = <Φ(xi), Φ(xj)>。这样就避免了在高维空间中直接运算的巨大开销。
1. 选择一个核函数 k（如 RBF、多项式核等），计算 N×N 的核矩阵 K，其中 K_ij = k(xi, xj)。
2. 对核矩阵进行中心化（求全局均值，使得映射后的数据在特征空间中零均值）。
3. 对中心化的核矩阵进行特征值分解，取最大的若干个特征值对应的特征向量。
4. 特征向量归一化后，即可用于将数据投影到低维特征空间。
• RBF（高斯核）：k(xi, xj) = exp(-γ||xi - xj||²)，最常用，能处理各种非线性结构，γ 控制灵敏度。
• 多项式核：k(xi, xj) = (γ<xi, xj> + r)^d，适合数据本身具有多项式关系的场景。
